scope: All published owners on18 assigned primitive/form pages, including internal and group masters
method: Current published property graph and full per-variant/descendant appearance metadata
Current get_design_context with default screenshot for every direct mapped family; DateInput and standalone DatePicker sparse masters drilled into child specimens
25 current Figma screenshots downloaded using tool-provided curl instructions; tool asset URLs redacted from saved contexts
No source/Figma edits; no runtime zoo and no runtime visual parity claim
priorityPolicy: Key screens and consequential variant, state, geometry, token, type or reusable-API differences; minor insets/row density are observations. Conditional gaps are not universal fix requirements.
limitations: Actual extant variants were captured; arbitrary property overrides and every Cartesian combination were not rendered.
Some imported icon masters have missing identity in extraction; imported geometry/fill/text/bindings remain captured.
Code Connect snippets point to upstream @ds/ui and are not proof of current local styles.
No runtime visual comparisons, viewport checks, keyboard tests or accessible-name browser queries were run. Source accessibility findings are identified as such.

findings.title: Name compact ComboButton actions
findings.claim: Compact branches render only Icon in the main button and the API exposes no text/name prop. App.tsx:3305 currently uses that branch; the main action is unnamed in source. Dropdown uses only aria-label despite the project requirement for in-button text.
findings.recommendation: Add an accessible-name path that renders sr-only text in both internal buttons through the upstream design system bundle.
findings.fixScope: necessary for the current compact list-screen action

findings.title: Preserve Button icon slot geometry
findings.claim: Local CSS forces start/end SVGs to16px for both mapped sizes. Current Figma startElement is24px in medium and20px in small; passing a larger Icon cannot escape the descendant selector.
findings.recommendation: Use size-specific element dimensions from the current Figma slots; inspect actual key-screen icon rendering before changing every callsite.
findings.fixScope: relevant to current Share, Manage Parties and filter CTAs

findings.title: Represent the two ComboBox field families explicitly
findings.claim: The template targets non-editable Combobox but source always filters via text input and shows a clear button whenever value is set, together with the chevron. It cannot configure size, leading element, trigger/clear alternatives, groups/loading/cascading, option descriptions or slots.
findings.recommendation: Expose the family choices needed by actual agreement/recipient/settings screens, then update the local mapping from the upstream bundle. Do not hand-roll a second select widget.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Use the current ComboBox listbox surface
findings.claim: All three current Figma listbox roots are white with10% neutral stroke and low elevation. Code uses glass frost, blur10px, a2px border and box-shadow:none. The comment claiming no Figma shadow is stale.
findings.recommendation: Replace stale surface assumptions in the upstream source with the current white/elevation treatment; verify on a key form screen.
findings.fixScope: when a key screen opens ComboBox

findings.title: Make DatePicker labels and keyboard opening work
findings.claim: label is rendered without htmlFor and the input is not nested in it. Opening is attached to a div click with no keyboard handler or calendar trigger button; the value is controlled/readOnly with no native typing change path.
findings.recommendation: Associate label/error/help IDs with the input and provide a named keyboard-operable picker trigger in the upstream component.
findings.fixScope: necessary when DatePicker is used on a key date/filter screen

findings.title: Expose only the required DateInput/calendar capabilities
findings.claim: DateInput size/usePicker/readOnly axes are omitted. No standalone/mobile/month-year-selector/date-range mode exists; both digit families have40px cells and range states that are not represented.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize small date filters, no-picker/typed entry or range selection only when required by a selected key screen. Treat internal calendar/digit owners as implementation parts rather than five new mandatory exports.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Correct calendar selection emphasis and typography
findings.claim: Current selected digit backgrounds are dark cobalt #260559 with white text. Local selected day uses cobalt60 #a598ff, white and semibold; current calendar day text is16/400, source is14/400. This changes selected-state contrast and density beyond small inset tolerance.
findings.recommendation: Use the current selected semantic fill and16px day typography in the upstream calendar; verify selected/today/disabled states on the selected key screen.
findings.fixScope: when a key screen opens the calendar

findings.title: Associate Switch label and disabled copy
findings.claim: The label prop becomes a sibling span outside the label containing the input, so the visible label does not name/toggle it. Disabled opacity affects only the control. With description but no label, description is discarded by the label&& branch.
findings.recommendation: Connect text and description to the switch and apply disabled treatment to the whole labeled control in the upstream bundle.
findings.fixScope: necessary whenever a key settings screen uses labeled Switch

findings.title: Support Badge menuTrigger when required
findings.claim: Current published Status Badge has menuTrigger boolean, with hidden chevron layers on every kind. Local Badge props, render and template do not expose it.
findings.recommendation: Add an accessible menu-trigger variant upstream if a selected key screen uses interactive status badges; static status badges need no workaround.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Preserve Avatar fallback identity and optional treatments
findings.claim: Square/no-image/no-initials variants use buildingCompany; local fallback always uses person and60% dimensions. Figma exposes shadow/badge/border but local API has none.
findings.recommendation: Implement the square entity fallback and optional treatments required by selected person/party/recipient screens in the upstream bundle.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Surface the existing AvatarGroup through the barrel
findings.claim: AvatarGroup.tsx exists but Avatar/index.ts and the top-level barrel do not export it. Consumers following AGENTS.md cannot reuse it without a prohibited deep import.
findings.recommendation: Export and document the existing group upstream if multi-avatar key screens require it; verify its overlap border treatment.
findings.fixScope: conditional family/export coverage

findings.title: Allow IconButton notification badge
findings.claim: Published badge boolean controls the positioned AlertBadge dot. Local IconButton renders only Icon and its mapping deliberately omits badge.
findings.recommendation: Expose the optional badge upstream when a selected shell or notification key screen needs it.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Make Text Box slots available without custom controls
findings.claim: Current Text Box exposes leading/trailing elements, inputHelp and characterCount. Local Input API has none and renders only the native input between label and error. These cannot be configured through its template.
findings.recommendation: Add required slots/help/counter capabilities upstream for selected form screens, using SearchInput for its existing dedicated search case.
findings.fixScope: conditional on a key screen using this capability

findings.title: Keep TextArea leading-element gap explicit
findings.claim: Live startElement boolean has no code prop. Existing other states, read-only surface and character-count API are present.
findings.recommendation: Only add a leading slot upstream if a selected key screen requires one.
findings.fixScope: conditional coverage

findings.title: Match visible Spinner ring geometry
findings.claim: Figma INSIDE strokes occupy16/40/80px with2/4/8px widths. SVG viewBox50 and r20 yields actual outer diameters14.8/36/72px inside those containers; stroke width alone is matched.
findings.recommendation: Check ring geometry at the key loading screen and adjust circle radius/viewBox in the upstream component.
findings.fixScope: key loading-state geometry

findings.title: Use emphasis red for StatusLight alert text
findings.claim: Current alert Status Text uses #a6003f (emphasis red100). Local .alert .text uses --ink-font-color-error (#c70547, red90).
findings.recommendation: Use the live emphasis semantic text token upstream when an alert light is used.
findings.fixScope: conditional alert-state token correction

findings.title: Connect Tooltip to its trigger semantically
findings.claim: Tooltip can appear on focus but the cloned trigger receives no aria-describedby and the portal tooltip has no ID; role=tooltip alone does not associate it with the control.
findings.recommendation: Provide a stable tooltip ID and preserve/append the trigger describedby in the upstream bundle.
findings.fixScope: necessary for key screens relying on tooltip descriptions

findings.title: Preserve 99+ AlertBadge text in translation
findings.claim: Template parseInt("99+",10) becomes99; runtime only renders99+ for values greater than99. The translated badge therefore loses its plus sign. parseInt(... )||1 also changes0 to1.
findings.recommendation: Normalize capped count text to a value greater than99, preserving the visible output.
findings.fixScope: mapping-only observation

findings.title: Keep Radio error icon difference visible
findings.claim: Figma radio error specimen uses a status-error icon next to error copy. Radio.tsx renders only the string, unlike Checkbox which renders the icon.
findings.recommendation: Add the error icon upstream if aligning an error-heavy selected key screen; do not treat this as a full-flow blocker.
findings.fixScope: conditional visual observation

findings.title: Review extra text Button shadows
findings.claim: All40 current Figma Button roots have effects=[]; brand/primary/danger CSS adds resting and hover shadows.
findings.recommendation: Inspect key-screen appearance before removing the extra shadows upstream.
findings.fixScope: low-priority surface observation

findings.title: Use medium weight for visible Spinner label
findings.claim: Current hidden-by-default /text layers are14px weight500; local .labelVisible is14px weight400.
findings.recommendation: Use weight500 upstream if the selected key loading screen shows the label.
findings.fixScope: conditional typography observation
